## Modules

- [PUI](https://pui.hexdocs.pm/PUI.md): PUI keeps the contexts that define your domain
and business logic.
- [PUI.Accordion](https://pui.hexdocs.pm/PUI.Accordion.md): Accordion primitives for progressively revealing related content.
- [PUI.Alert](https://pui.hexdocs.pm/PUI.Alert.md): Alert component for displaying important messages and status updates.
- [PUI.Button](https://pui.hexdocs.pm/PUI.Button.md): A versatile button component with multiple variants and sizes.
- [PUI.ButtonGroup](https://pui.hexdocs.pm/PUI.ButtonGroup.md): A container that groups related buttons together with consistent styling.
- [PUI.Chart](https://pui.hexdocs.pm/PUI.Chart.md): uPlot-backed chart components for Phoenix LiveView.
- [PUI.Components](https://pui.hexdocs.pm/PUI.Components.md)
- [PUI.Container](https://pui.hexdocs.pm/PUI.Container.md): Container components for organizing content with consistent styling.
- [PUI.DatePicker](https://pui.hexdocs.pm/PUI.DatePicker.md): Date picker components built from a trigger button and a popover calendar.
- [PUI.DatePickerComponent](https://pui.hexdocs.pm/PUI.DatePickerComponent.md)
- [PUI.Dialog](https://pui.hexdocs.pm/PUI.Dialog.md): A modal dialog component for LiveView applications.
- [PUI.Dropdown](https://pui.hexdocs.pm/PUI.Dropdown.md): Dropdown menu component for displaying actions and options.
- [PUI.Flash](https://pui.hexdocs.pm/PUI.Flash.md): Toast notification system for LiveView applications.
- [PUI.Flash.Message](https://pui.hexdocs.pm/PUI.Flash.Message.md)
- [PUI.Input](https://pui.hexdocs.pm/PUI.Input.md): Form controls for text inputs, checkboxes, radios, switches, labels, and textareas.
- [PUI.Layout](https://pui.hexdocs.pm/PUI.Layout.md): Reusable application shell primitives for documentation sites, dashboards, and
other two-pane LiveView layouts.
- [PUI.Loading](https://pui.hexdocs.pm/PUI.Loading.md): Loading indicators and progress components.
- [PUI.MenuButton](https://pui.hexdocs.pm/PUI.MenuButton.md): A button that opens a popup menu. Built on top of Popover.
- [PUI.Popover](https://pui.hexdocs.pm/PUI.Popover.md): Popover and tooltip components using Floating UI for positioning.
- [PUI.Select](https://pui.hexdocs.pm/PUI.Select.md): A customizable select dropdown with search, grouping, and form-aware errors.
- [PUI.Tabs](https://pui.hexdocs.pm/PUI.Tabs.md): Accessible tabs for switching between related panels of content.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix pui.gen.skills](https://pui.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Pui.Gen.Skills.md): Generate PUI skills into agent skill directories.
